preprocessing.noise: clean Lanczos alignment to noise native size per Method B protocol

protocol.normalization: verifier.embed output is L2-normalized; score is dot product cosine
protocol.distance_metric: cosine similarity / dot product of L2-normalized embeddings
protocol.negative_mining_strategy: hardest negative = max similarity over all wrong clean gallery sources

notes: Cosine and margin CIs bootstrap source blocks with seed 13 and 2000 samples.
No Top1/AUC/EER is used as a Table3 headline metric.
